description_en: Creates a Resource Access Management (RAM) user
kebab_example: aliyun ims create-user --user-principal-name Test@example.onaliyun.com --display-name test --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateUser

parameters.help_en:
The logon Resource Access Management (RAM) user.

The format is `<username>@<AccountAlias>.onaliyun.com`, where `<username>` is the Resource Access Management (RAM) user and `<AccountAlias>.onaliyun.com` is the default domain name. For more information about how to obtain the default domain name, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/186720.html.

The UserPrincipalName parameter must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), hyphens (-), and underscores (_). The `<username>` part must be 1 to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
RAM用户的登录名称。

格式为`<username>@<AccountAlias>.onaliyun.com`，其中`<username>`为RAM用户名称，`<AccountAlias>.onaliyun.com`为默认域名。 关于如何获取默认域名，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/186720.html。

`UserPrincipalName`总长度为`1~128`个字符，可包含英文字母、数字、半角句号（.）、短划线（-）和下划线（_）。其中`<username>`的长度为`1~64`个字符
parameters.name: user_principal_name

parameters.help_en:
The display name of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user.

The display name must be 1 to 24 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
RAM用户的显示名称。

长度为1~24个字符
parameters.name: display_name

parameters.help_en:
The mobile phone number of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user.

Format: area code-phone number.

This parameter is applicable only to the China site
parameters.help_zh:
RAM用户的手机号码。

格式：国际区号-号码。

该参数仅适用于中国站
parameters.name: mobile_phone

parameters.help_en:
The electron mailbox of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user.
This parameter is applicable only to the China site
parameters.help_zh:
RAM用户的电子邮箱。
该参数仅适用于中国站
parameters.name: email

parameters.example: This is a cloud computing engineer.
parameters.help_en:
The description.

The description must be 1 to 128 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
备注。

长度为1~128个字符
parameters.name: comments

fields.help_en:
The tag key.

Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with aliyun or acs:. It cannot contain http:// or https://
fields.help_zh:
标签键。

N的取值范围：1~20。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value.

Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with acs:. It cannot contain http:// or https://
fields.help_zh:
标签值。

N的取值范围：1~20。可以为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The list of tags. A maximum of 20 tags can be added
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表。最多包含20个标签
parameters.name: tag

User.description_en: The Resource Access Management (RAM) user information

Comments.example: This is a cloud computing engineer.

CreateDate.description_en:
The creation time of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user.

Format: RFC 3339 (UTC), such as 2020-10-12T09:12:00Z
CreateDate.description_zh:
RAM用户的创建时间。

格式：RFC 3339（UTC），例如：2020-10-12T09:12:00Z

DisplayName.description_en: The display name of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user

Email.description_en:
The electron mailbox of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user.
This parameter is applicable only to the China site
Email.description_zh:
RAM用户的电子邮箱。
该参数仅适用于中国站

LastLoginDate.description_en:
The time of the last logon to the console by the Resource Access Management (RAM) user.

Format: RFC 3339 (UTC), such as 2020-10-12T09:12:00Z
LastLoginDate.description_zh:
RAM用户最近一次登录控制台的时间。

格式：RFC 3339（UTC），例如：2020-10-12T09:12:00Z

MobilePhone.description_en:
The mobile phone number of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user.
This parameter is applicable only to the China site
MobilePhone.description_zh:
RAM用户的手机号码。
该参数仅适用于中国站

ProvisionType.description_en:
The provision type. Valid values:
Manual: The Resource Access Management (RAM) user is manually created in RAM.
SCIM: The Resource Access Management (RAM) user is created through the System for Cross-domain Identity Management protocol.
CloudSSO: The user is created through CloudSSO synchronization
ProvisionType.description_zh:
同步类型。取值：
Manual：在RAM中手动创建的RAM用户。
SCIM：通过SCIM协议同步创建的RAM用户。
CloudSSO：通过云SSO同步创建的用户

UpdateDate.description_en:
The update time of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user.

Format: RFC 3339 (UTC), such as 2020-10-12T09:12:00Z
UpdateDate.description_zh:
RAM用户的更新时间。

格式：RFC 3339（UTC），例如：2020-10-12T09:12:00Z

UserId.description_en: The ID of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user

UserPrincipalName.description_en: The logon name of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user
